profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, Illumina Inc
profile.summary: I am a software engineering manager with experience in leading a team through all aspects of the software development life cycle. I have over 14 years of experience as an engineer developing complex and scalable systems to manage data and services.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Lead a team tasked with creating a workflow tracking and analysis system utilizing J2EE
● Instituted SCRUM methodologies to increase team effectiveness by completing twice as many story points
● Created reports for management detailing product activity status and technical challenges
● Responsible for architecting new system focusing on microservices
● Core team member building relations between business and technical members improving cooperation and overall project results
● Liaison for Ancestry.com by analyzing business needs and translating them to stakeholders and development team(in the form of workflows, design docs and stories)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Lead developer for the DPS LIMS system, a genotyping sample prep workflow for our biggest customer Ancestry.com
● Coordinate with stakeholders to devise road maps and feature priority with given timelines
● Managed and groomed the backlog with product owner to maximize development with given resources
● Architected data quality control service that minimized manual decision making by 50%
● Optimized DPS to increase customer throughput by 4.5x
● Architected and implemented a message queue to improve robustness and minimized downtime by 80% which aided the decision of a 24/7 lab
● Key development team member for the Symphony LIMS system which is a sample prep workflow for our sequencing products
● Helped architect a configurable workflow to cut development time up to 50%

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
● Key development team member for the Symphony LIMS system which is a sample prep workflow for our sequencing products
● Helped architect a configurable workflow to cut development time up to 50%

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Key development team member for a proprietary system to aggregate and improve all maritime data and communication between the different military divisions
● Used GWT (Google Web Toolkit) to prototype a light weight visual aggregation of maritime data, which lead to a successful contract bid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Key development team member on a scalable backend platform to house gaming and application services
● Ported J2ME games such as ‘World Poker Tour: Texas Hold ‘Em’, to increase coverage on J2ME handsets up to 99%
